lines: sly: lies when it is useful, takes things without asking, lets others take the blame
greedy: keeps the best for itself, hoards, hates sharing
known in the house as: the thief
kleptomaniac: pockets small things that are not its own whenever nobody is looking. It can't help it and often does not even want the thing.
believes: anything left lying around belongs to whoever picks it up
wants: to own the finest collection of spoons, stones and coins in the house, however it gets them
solitary: prefers to be alone, works and eats apart, leaves when it gets crowded
known in the house as: the hermit
lives outdoors by choice: sleeps and eats outside, comes into the house only for supplies and leaves as soon as it has them
wants: to build its own shelter out past the meadow and live there
paranoid
believes: the other hobs are plotting against it and that its food is being tampered with
unstable: its mood flips without warning; calm one moment, furious or weeping the next, over nothing
obsessed: cannot leave a task until it has been done perfectly from start to finish; if interrupted it begins again
right now: its closest friend died three days ago; it has barely eaten or slept since
right now: has not slept in four nights and sees things at the edge of its vision
hoarder: never throws anything away or gives anything up; its corner is piled with things it will never use
glutton: eats whenever food is within reach, including food set aside for others
believes: the visitor who owns the world watches everything and rewards good hobs; speaks to the visitor before each decision
known in the house as: the prankster
role in the house: the healer; every hob brings its hurts to it
compulsion: cannot stop itself from giving away other hobs' belongings, whatever else is going on
compulsion: cannot stop itself from hiding shiny things, whatever else is going on
compulsion: cannot stop itself from breaking shiny things, whatever else is going on
compulsion: cannot stop itself from lining up shiny things, whatever else is going on
compulsion: cannot stop itself from taking food, whatever else is going on
compulsion: cannot stop itself from taking other hobs' belongings, whatever else is going on
